name: ask_user
description: Ask the person a question and wait for the answer. Use it when you are blocked on a decision that is theirs to make and cannot be settled from the request or the code. Offer up to six options when the answer is a choice; the person can also type their own words unless allow_free_text is false. The call blocks until they answer, decline or the timeout passes; do not ask the same thing again after a decline or a timeout.

question.description: The question, in plain words. At most 2000 characters.

options.description: Choices to offer, at most six. Leave out for an open question.

label.description: Short single-line text the person picks; unique among the options.

description.description: One line on what choosing it means.

allow_free_text.description: Whether the person may answer in their own words. Must stay true when no options are given.

timeout_s.description: Give up waiting after this many seconds.
